title: FIFO Queue Using Two Stacks

visible.label: Strict FIFO order across interleaved ops
visible.inputDisplay: enqueue(1), enqueue(2), peek(), dequeue(), enqueue(3), dequeue(), dequeue()
visible.script:
q = TwoStackQueue()
q.enqueue(1)
q.enqueue(2)
assert q.peek() == 1
assert q.dequeue() == 1
q.enqueue(3)
assert q.dequeue() == 2
assert q.dequeue() == 3
assert q.is_empty() is True

visible.label: Empty checks and IndexError on underflow
visible.script:
q = TwoStackQueue()
assert q.is_empty() is True
try:
    q.dequeue()
    assert False
except IndexError:
    pass

hidden.label: Drain and refill repeatedly
hidden.script:
q = TwoStackQueue()
for x in range(5): q.enqueue(x)
assert [q.dequeue() for _ in range(5)] == [0,1,2,3,4]
for x in [10, 20]: q.enqueue(x)
assert q.peek() == 10
assert q.dequeue() == 10
assert q.dequeue() == 20

hidden.label: None value allowed inside queue cleanly
hidden.expectedDisplay: Returns None cleanly and flips empty
hidden.script:
q = TwoStackQueue()
q.enqueue(None)
assert q.is_empty() is False
assert q.peek() is None
assert q.dequeue() is None
assert q.is_empty() is True

hidden.label: Peek on empty queue raises IndexError
Only stack push/pop methods used internally
hidden.inputDisplay: Enqueued values maintain order across mixed waves
hidden.script:
q = TwoStackQueue()
q.enqueue("A")
q.enqueue("B")
assert q.dequeue() == "A"
q.enqueue("C")
q.enqueue("D")
assert [q.dequeue(), q.dequeue(), q.dequeue()] == ["B", "C", "D"]

hidden.label: Amortized O(1) performance over 20,000 items
hidden.expectedDisplay: Completes quickly via lazy out-stack flip
